subject: DevHealth: implementation stewardship, kickoff timing & owner
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lina Morales <lina@devhealth.co>, DevHealth Implementation <implementation@devhealth.co>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DevHealth: implementation stewardship, kickoff timing & owner

Hi Lina / DevHealth team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Quick recap and handoff notes so the implementation team has everything up front:

- Deal: Pilot -> reserved Dedicated pool for 3 months, then transition to monthly reserved capacity (RDW-DEAL-004219).
- Primary use case: in-product chat for care coordination (average prompt length ~ 180 tokens, bursty during business hours).
- Key constraints: SOC2+HIPAA evidence needed, VPC peering for production, and SSO via Okta.

Attachments: devhealth_handoff_deck.pdf (overview, onboarding checklist) and devhealth_sow_draft_v1.docx (initial SOW, pricing/assumptions).

Next immediate asks from your side: access to a staging Okta test tenant, list of 3 sample prompts for eval, and an initial 2-hour kickoff window next week (preferably morning PT).

Internal notes for CS: customer expects a single steady owner and wants weekly status emails until go-live. They are sensitive to data residency (US-only) and will want audit logging details during security review.

Tessa / Marissa — can one of you take owner for the kickoff and the first 30 days of activation? I can stay in the loop for escalation and procurement coordination.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

--
Attachment: devhealth_handoff_deck.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)
Attachment: devhealth_sow_draft_v1.docx (DOCX, 120KB)

From: Lina Morales <lina@devhealth.co>

Cc: DevHealth Implementation <implementation@devhealth.co>, Procurement <procurement@devhealth.co>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DevHealth: implementation stewardship, kickoff timing & owner

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. A couple of quick clarifications from our side before the kickoff: 

1) For the Okta test tenant, we can provide credentials scoped to a staging environment. Is there anything specific you need beyond SAML metadata and a test user list?
2) For data residency, can you confirm all logs and backups for our account will remain in our specified US region (we'll share the exact region once legal signs off)?
3) Our procurement team has a handful of standard clauses; they prefer to review the SOW before the kickoff. Procurement (cc'd) will follow up with a redline timeline.

We are available for a 2-hour kickoff next Tuesday (Apr 13) 9–11am PT or Thursday (Apr 15) 8–10am PT. Let us know which works.

Appreciate it,
Lina Morales
Director, Product Integrations | DevHealth
lina@devhealth.co

--

Thanks for the context — picking this up.

Quick internal read:
- Security asks: SOC2 artifacts + KMS/HSM key management details (we should prepare a short packet).
- Network: they want VPC peering — Platform Eng will need the subnet/CIDR info and preferred region.
- SSO: we support Okta SAML, but staging constraints may require a short-lived API key for early testing.

I can be the primary owner for kickoff + first 30 days. Marissa, can you lead post-kickoff enablement (runbooks, playbooks, CS health checks)? Vivek, can you confirm availability for a 75-minute technical deep-dive after kickoff?

I'll reply to the customer shortly to confirm dates and introduce the team.

Appreciate the quick pickup, Tessa. I'm fine with you owning the first 30 days. A couple of internal notes to preserve in the handoff thread: 
- Customer will want weekly status updates every Friday until go-live and a single escalation contact from our side.
- Budget sensitivity: pilot approved, but expansion is contingent on proving 30-day latency and cost targets in staging.
- Procurement will likely request a 30-day review period after SOW redlines.

For scheduling: Lina suggested Apr 13 (Tue) 9–11am PT or Apr 15 (Thu) 8–10am PT. Tessa — can you confirm which window works for you and Marissa? Vivek, please signal whether Apr 15 afternoon (1–2:15pm PT) works for the technical deep-dive.

Subject: Intro — your Redwood CS lead for DevHealth (kickoff & next steps)

Hi Lina and team —

Nice to meet you virtually. I'm Marissa and I'll be your CS lead for post-kickoff enablement and the onboarding playbook. Tessa will run the kickoff and initial 30-day activation. Vivek will join for the technical deep-dive.

Proposed agenda for the 2-hour kickoff (we can adjust):
1) Intros & goals (10m)
2) Production vs staging architecture review (20m)
3) SSO & networking checklist (25m)
4) Evaluation plan and success criteria (25m)
5) SOW/contract Q&A and procurement timeline (20m)
6) Next steps & action owners (20m)

Action items we need from DevHealth prior to kickoff:
- Okta staging SAML metadata + 2 test users
- CIDR range for VPC peering
- 3 representative prompts and expected concurrency profile
- Any mandatory contract redlines from procurement (if available)

Would Apr 13 9–11am PT work for the kickoff? If procurement needs to sign off on SOW first, we can do a pre-kickoff alignment with your procurement rep.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
